recipe.visualDefinition: A retro-styled album cover featuring a close-up portrait of a female vocalist with a 1950s bouffant hairstyle, set against a split-color background of deep red and purple, framed by bold typographic headers and a yellow footer bar.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject portrait occupies the left two-thirds of the frame against a red backdrop.
A vertical purple sidebar on the right contains secondary track information.
A primary title bar at the top spans the full width in high-contrast white.
A horizontal yellow banner at the bottom serves as a secondary information anchor.
coreInvariants: 1950s-era studio lighting with soft shadows on the face.
Condensed, italicized sans-serif for the main title.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium-close up portrait, slightly off-center to the left, scaled to fill the height of the central red panel.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and hands, specifically the expressive 'whispering' gesture.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large white title at the top, moves down to the subject's face, then right to the track list, and finally to the yellow footer.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Tight composition with minimal negative space, using color blocks to separate information zones.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted Royal Purple (sidebar and top header background).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red and yellow; lower value/darker tone in the purple for depth.

letterConstructionRules: Main title: Extra-condensed, heavy-weight, italicized sans-serif.
Secondary text: High-contrast serif with sharp terminals.
Footer text: Bold, all-caps geometric sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Italicized 'C' and 'S' in the main title have extreme vertical compression.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a modern, aggressive sans-serif header and a classic, elegant serif for body details.

preserve: Italic slant of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, heavy, italicized feel of the main header.
Captures the high-contrast serif elegance of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman with a 1950s bouffant hairstyle and lace dress against a split background: the left 70% is deep red, the right 30% is dark purple. Leave a solid purple bar at the top and a solid yellow bar at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the main title in white condensed italic sans-serif in the top purple bar. Place the track list in white serif font on the right purple section. Add a single line of black sans-serif text in the bottom yellow bar.

verificationChecks: Is the main title white and italicized?
Is there a clear vertical split between red and purple backgrounds?
Does the subject have a mid-century aesthetic?
Is the yellow bar at the very bottom?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of red (from crimson to brick)
Font weight of the main title
mustRedesign: Any modern digital artifacts or filters
Lowercase letters in the main title
postGenerationChecks: Check for three distinct color zones (Red, Purple, Yellow).
Ensure the main title is the largest visual element.
Verify the subject's hands are visible and expressive.
Confirm the text in the yellow bar is black and centered.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait on Red + Purple Sidebar + Yellow Footer + Condensed Italic Header
